contribution.position: My position is unchanged. Peak-load run_time is 118s against a 60s budget, and the other seats' 45s figure does not cover peak load. Both sev2 incidents last quarter were retry storms, and a run that overshoots its budget can hit timeouts and trigger retries. The passing tests (412 passed, 87% coverage) do not measure load behavior, so they do not offset the perf result. The cost and runbook points are fine on their own axes, but neither addresses retry amplification. Still needed: retry and timeout settings checked against the 118s figure, plus a load test showing retries stay bounded. A documented waiver or a revised budget would also close the gap.
